description: Checkpointed Revision Loop - Guarantee iterative revision loops with explicit checkpoints and no silent data loss between rounds.

userStories.title: Create explicit checkpoint artifacts per revision round
userStories.description: As an operator, I want each revision round to emit explicit checkpoint artifacts so that loop progress is deterministic and auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Each revision round writes a checkpoint artifact with round identifier and stage metadata
Checkpoint artifacts are persisted in the configured local-first project path
Checkpoint creation is deterministic across repeated runs for the same inputs
researchTopics: Existing checkpoint/state snapshot patterns in workflow and revision loop modules
Artifact naming and storage conventions used by .aha-loop evidence and logs

userStories.title: Resume revision loop from latest valid checkpoint
userStories.description: As an operator, I want recovery/resume to restore from the latest valid checkpoint so that interrupted revision loops can continue without corruption.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery path locates the latest valid checkpoint for a revision loop
Resume restores loop state from checkpoint without state corruption
Invalid or partial checkpoints are rejected with explicit failure handling
researchTopics: Validation strategy for checkpoint integrity before resume
Failure-mode handling patterns for partial writes in current workflow engine
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-001 stable workflow state schema.

userStories.title: Capture revision evidence through loop transitions
userStories.description: As a QA/release stakeholder, I want before/after and pass/fail revision evidence captured at loop transitions so that revision reliability can be verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Revision evidence records before and after artifacts for each transition
Evidence includes per-round pass/fail outcomes linked to checkpoint identifiers
Evidence output follows project evidence artifact contract
researchTopics: PRD-002 evidence artifact contract fields required for revision outcomes
Current evidence generation hooks in revision and quality pipeline
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-002 evidence artifacts for revision outcomes.
